title: Breakout
description: Bounce the ball, smash every brick and grab power-ups: wide paddle, multi-ball and slow motion. Six hand-made levels that loop faster and tougher, with your best score saved on this device.
instructions: Press Play, then tap, click or press Space to launch the ball.
Move the paddle with your mouse, finger or the arrow keys — where the ball hits the paddle sets its angle.
Catch falling capsules: W widens the paddle, M splits the ball, S slows it down, + gives an extra life.
Press P to pause, M to mute and F for fullscreen. Your best score is stored locally.
